data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that renders clickable links within text.
data.what_it_does: Wraps RichText to detect URLs, email addresses, and phone numbers and makes them tappable. Uses url_launcher to open the appropriate app when a link is pressed. Works on all major Flutter platforms.
use_when: You need simple clickable links inside plain or rich text.
You want automatic detection of web URLs, mailto, and tel links without writing custom regexes.
Cross‑platform support (mobile, web, desktop) is required.
avoid_when: You need full markdown rendering or advanced rich‑text features.
You require extensive styling per link or custom link actions beyond opening URLs.
You prefer a solution that does not depend on url_launcher.
strengths: Zero‑configuration detection of URLs, emails, and phone numbers
Works out‑of‑the‑box on Android, iOS, web, and desktop
Lightweight wrapper around existing RichText widget
weaknesses: Limited to basic link detection and styling
Relies on url_launcher, adding extra dependency and native setup
No markdown or rich‑text parsing beyond simple links
data.setup_notes: Add url_launcher to pubspec. On Android add <queries> entries in AndroidManifest.xml; on iOS add LSApplicationQueriesSchemes for tel in Info.plist.
